pairs: Jesus autem perrexit in montem Oliveti:
But Jesus continued on to the Mount of Olives.
et diluculo iterum venit in templum,
And early in the morning, he went again to the temple;
et omnis populus venit ad eum,
and all the people came to him.
And sitting down, he taught them.

Now the scribes and Pharisees brought forward a woman caught in adultery,
and they stood her in front of them.

Et non cognoverunt quia Patrem ejus dicebat Deum.
And they did not realize that he was calling God his Father.
And so Jesus said to them:
“When you will have lifted up the Son of man,
then you shall realize that I am,
and that I do nothing of myself,
but just as the Father has taught me,
et qui me misit, mecum est,
And he who sent me is with me,
and he has not abandoned me alone.
quia ego quæ placita sunt ei, facio semper.
For I always do what is pleasing to him.”
As he was speaking these things,
Dicebat ergo Jesus ad eos, qui crediderunt ei,
Therefore, Jesus said to those Jews who believed in him:
Judæos: Si vos manseritis in sermone meo,
“If you will abide in my word,
you will truly be my disciples.
And you shall know the truth,
and the truth shall set you free.”
and we have never been a slave to anyone.

Servus autem non manet in domo in æternum:
Now the slave does not abide in the house for eternity.
Yet the Son does abide in eternity.
Therefore, if the Son has set you free,
then you will truly be free.
I know that you are sons of Abraham.
But you are seeking to kill me,
quia sermo meus non capit in vobis.
because my word has not taken hold in you.
Ego quod vidi apud Patrem meum, loquor:
I speak what I have seen with my Father.
et vos quæ vidistis apud patrem vestrum, facitis.
And you do what you have seen with your father.”
“If you are the sons of Abraham,
then do the works of Abraham.
But now you are seeking to kill me,
hominem, qui veritatem vobis locutus sum,
a man who has spoken the truth to you,
which I have heard from God.
This is not what Abraham did.
You do the works of your father.”
Nos ex fornicatione non sumus nati:
“We were not born out of fornication.
For I did not come from myself,
Why do you not recognize my speech?
Quia non potestis audire sermonem meum.
It is because you are not able to hear my word.
You are of your father, the devil.
et desideria patris vestri vultis facere.
And you will carry out the desires of your father.
He was a murderer from the beginning.
And he did not stand in the truth,
quia non est veritas in eo:
because the truth is not in him.
cum loquitur mendacium, ex propriis loquitur,
When he speaks a lie, he speaks it from his own self.
quia mendax est, et pater ejus.
For he is a liar, and the father of lies.
But if I speak the truth,
Quis ex vobis arguet me de peccato?
Which of you can convict me of sin?
If I speak the truth to you,
why do you not believe me?
For this reason, you do not hear them:
because you are not of God.”
the Jews responded and said to him,
Nonne bene dicimus nos quia Samaritanus es tu,

Ego autem non quæro gloriam meam:
But I am not seeking my own glory.
if anyone will have kept my word,
he will not see death for eternity.”
“Now we know that you have a demon.
Abraham is dead, and the Prophets;
‘If anyone will have kept my word,
he shall not taste death for eternity.’
Numquid tu major es patre nostro Abraham,
Are you greater than our father Abraham,
So who do you make yourself to be?”
est Pater meus, qui glorificat me,

quem vos dicitis quia Deus vester est,

then I would be like you,
Abraham pater vester exsultavit ut videret diem meum:
